description: This is a Perl script for flashing firmware onto a D-Link DSL-G6x4T device. It includes network communication, device detection, FTP interactions, and firmware transfer logic.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP with custom methods for executing specific commands like getenv and reboot tailored for interacting with the ADAM2 device.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script and exits.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Overrides the USER command for the FTP connection to ensure uppercase command usage.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieves environment variable values from the FTP server.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method that wraps _GETENV to get variables like 'mtd0' and 'mtd1'.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Issues the REBOOT command to the FTP server to reboot the device.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Public method to reboot the device via FTP and close the connection.
